Production totals across the selected games

Each number below covers all 5 recorded appearances (2026-10-15 to 2026-10-24) and 102.00 total minutes of ice time. These are totals across those games, not per-game averages.

Actual total: what the player recorded across those games.
Historical comparison total: the historical production rate applied to the same ice time. The weights above show how much comes from the player’s history and how much comes from a position-group estimate; reference age is shown separately. This is not the player’s historical per-game average.
Support comparison total: adjusts the historical comparison using changes in the player’s own scoring chances and team chances for and against while they are on the ice. These chance measures use expected goals (xG), which estimate scoring opportunity. Missing or estimated inputs remain flagged above. This is a retrospective model comparison, not a forecast or proof of good or bad luck.
Gap: support comparison minus actual total. Positive means recorded production was lower; negative means it was higher.
